author: Uslueronur
quote: Title: A Huge Disappointment After Years of WaitingI pre-ordered GTA VI with high expectations, but unfortunately, the game has been a huge disappointment for me. The graphics look blurry and muddy at times, character movements feel heavy and sluggish, and the driving mechanics are surprisingly poor. Cars feel difficult to control, steering is inconsistent, and managing speed is **** a game with such a massive budget and years of development, I expected a much more polished experience. Even older games offer more satisfying driving mechanics.After playing for less than an hour, I already regretted my purchase. The game simply doesn’t justify its high price in its current state. A beautiful world means very little when the actual gameplay doesn’t feel enjoyable.
